text:
Type: shaggy high-pile area rug
Use: softening floors around a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: long loose shag pile, soft fluffy yarn
Colors: warm off-white, cream, light beige flecks
Shape: rectangle with deep loose shag texture, fluffy uneven surface, thick and soft, medium-large, cushy visual weight
Feel: cosy, soft, bright, inviting
Goes with: white or light grey sofas, light wood, white walls, pastel textiles; Scandinavian or contemporary bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: GSER
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
